# workbench Provider

## Example Usage

### Using Workbench CLI credentials (recommended for local development)

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    workbench = {
      source  = "verily-src/workbench"
      version = ">= 0.0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "workbench" {
  host                = "https://workbench.verily.com"
  use_cli_credentials = true
}
```

**Note:** When using `use_cli_credentials = true`, you must first authenticate via the Workbench
CLI:

```bash
wb auth login
```

### Using application default credentials

```terraform
provider "workbench" {
  host = "https://workbench.verily.com"
}
```

**Note:** This works inside a workspace, but for local development it may fail if your account does
not have a GoogleSubjectId (true for most users created after 2025).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) example of a Workbench server is https://workbench.verily.com
- `impersonate_service_account` (String) Service account email to impersonate using default
  credentials. When set, the provider will use application default credentials to impersonate this
  service account.
- `use_cli_credentials` (Boolean) Set to true to use credentials from the Workbench CLI
  (`wb auth print-access-token`). Requires the CLI to be installed and authenticated via
  `wb auth login`. Recommended for local development.
- `use_id_token` (Boolean) Set to true to use a Workspace Identity ID token for authentication. Set
  to false for local development.
